details.text: The code a-other is marked as noMap, but the reverse map http://example.org/fhir/mapping-validation/ConceptMap/mv-rev-other-broader|1.0.0 maps b-other to a-other as 'source-is-broader-than-target', which means that a-other could be mapped to b-other as 'source-is-narrower-than-target'
